page.overview:
Who is Diabolos?

Diabolos is an antagonist in Final Fantasy XIV, first appearing as the final boss in the level 50 dungeon, Lost City of Amdapor, and later in Final Fantasy XIV: Heavensward as the main antagonist in the "Shadow of Mhach" storyline.

Diabolos was a powerful voidsent recognized by the Allagan Empire, who created a superweapon called the Diablo Armament to bind him and harness his power through Emperor Xande's pact with the void. However, the Diablo Armament was lost and buried under what became Bozja in the Third Umbral Calamity, with Diabolos himself escaping mostly intact.

During the War of the Magi in the Fifth Astral Era, High Voidmage Cessair was commissioned by her city of Mhach to summon Diabolos into their world. Cessair, who was opposed to the war, intended to use the threat of Diabolos to bring about a swift end to the conflict. Instead, the other voidmages ignored the restrictions she had carefully placed upon Diabolos and decided to use him to devastate the city of Amdapor. When Cessair protested, she was imprisoned as a traitor and the voidmages were free to induce Diabolos to share secrets of the void; he provided them with flawed instructions on how to summon and control a powerful voidsent, Scathach, the Shadow Queen, planning to take her power as his own. When Diabolos attacked Amdapor, however, the city's White Mages sealed him within their ruined city and he entered a deep sleep for the next 1500 years.

As the magicks that sealed Diabolos began to weaken, powerful dark forces began emanating from the ruins of Amdapor. E-Sumi-Yan and Raya-O-Senna send the Warrior of Light to the Lost City of Amdapor to investigate. Upon reaching the final chamber, Diabolos's seal broke. The voidsent seemed disoriented, confusing the Warrior's party for the White Mages who had sealed him, before attacking. Upon defeat, he stated that his long sleep had weakened him and he was not yet at his full power before disappearing, seemingly vanquished.
